I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team. Nothing Dana can see confirms the 17 November deadline for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply:
- #north-team has no earlier mention of Marrow or Halyard.
- The shared files have no Marrow folder, and the general accounts listing came back empty too.
- Dana's calendar has nothing from October through December.

I told Dana the date stays unconfirmed and I won't use it as a real deadline. I suggested they check with the Marrow account owner or the customer contact. I only looked at what Dana can see: I didn't search other channels or anyone else's messages.
